before.summary: Special Council (June 29, 2026) consolidated major planning and finance decisions: presentations on Parks DCC updates, citywide Design Guidelines, and Environmental DPA mapping. Issued DVP25-0006 to expand the RCMP detachment (698 Atkins Ave. and adjacent properties); Councillor Guiry opposed. Approved the 2025 Statement of Financial Information; staff noted 2025 includes retro firefighter payments and staff increases explaining remuneration rises. Approved the Aquatic Centre supplementary agreement with YMCA/YWCA and directed creation of an Aquatic Centre Reserve Fund and staff to explore expanded youth programming. Gave readings/adopted a package of bylaws: zoning amendments (including new residential zones and small-scale multi-unit housing), OCP amendment to adopt consolidated Design Guidelines and updated EDPA maps, a new Tree Protection Bylaw, and adoption of Amenity Cost Charge and Inclusionary Zoning bylaws.

proposal.summary: Council adopted the Amenity Cost Charge, Inclusionary Zoning and Reserve Fund bylaws and approved new residential zoning. Council issued DVP25‑0006 for the RCMP detachment expansion (Councillor Guiry opposed) and directed staff to post notice that a DVP for 1320 Westhills will be considered, conditional on registered Section 219 no‑build covenants and geotechnical reports. Council approved the 2025 Statement of Financial Information and approved a supplementary agreement with the YMCA for the Langford Aquatic Centre, directing staff to establish an Aquatic Centre reserve and explore expanded grades‑6–12 programming. Council gave final readings to the Tree Protection Bylaw, first reading to OCP Form & Character and Environmental DPA amendments, and asked staff to bring forward a bylaw to establish an Advisory Design Panel; public speakers raised concerns about parks DCCs, the SOFI report and the Aquatic Centre materials.
